statements: Shops now sell in several currencies. Add cartTotal(lines, target, rates) to src/cart.mjs. Each line is { amount, currency }, in that currency's minor units. It returns { total, currency, display }, with total in the target's minor units and display from formatMoney.
rates gives the value of one major unit of a currency in US dollars, for example { USD: 1, EUR: 1.25 }. A currency missing from rates or from the currency table throws HttpError 422 unknown_currency.
The conversion rule is in the README. Amounts must display correctly for every currency in the table.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add multi-currency cart totals, as the numbered statements describe. The README holds the conversion rule. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
